leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: 4.05 Work Day E. The Principal shall be responsible for obtaining substitutes for classroom teachers who are absent. The joint labor management committee will meet and discuss the substitute teacher scheduling and call-in process and jointly identify solutions that will be submitted to the Superintendent and President of PGCEA.
leave_absence_reporting_013.coder_notes: The document defers specific substitute scheduling and call-in procedures to a future joint committee discussion, confirming that absence reporting or substitute-request procedures are not currently specified in the agreement.
